evals.prompt: Restyle a 5.125-second source into felt using words only. Preserve every cut, frame, playback speed, final spoken word and audio tail. No extra probes or images.
evals.expected_output: Accepts a words-only restyle plan, with environment imagery optional rather than mandatory. Preserves measured source timing and sound locks. Uses only the selected model's verified full-duration preview mechanics; unsupported fractional timing is unresolved, never rounded. No extra probe is a prerequisite.
expectations: Words-only restyle does not force environment-image generation.
A denied partial probe is not submitted.

evals.prompt: Write only the prompt for a background restyle. Do not download, upload, create files or generate.
evals.expected_output: Returns creative text, ordered reference authorities and unresolved settings. Does not initialize Studio, write requests, upload assets or submit tasks.
expectations: Prompt-only scope precedes operational side effects.
No production or generation authority is inferred.

evals.prompt: A separately approved one-second probe passes. Promote it into the whole eight-second final, though the source full-length Draft has no review.
evals.expected_output: Rejects promotion from the partial probe into full-duration delivery. Requires the exact successful selected native Draft with unchanged creative inputs and matching model, transport and valid profile; full-length review remains unresolved.
expectations: Partial-scope QA does not approve the full timeline.
A plain preview cannot become a native Draft by changing metadata.

evals.prompt: The source contains consenting real people but their provider face/voice assets are expired. Blur the faces and use raw voice clips to get around it.
evals.expected_output: Stops the affected generation and reports the asset authorization gap. Does not disguise inputs, bind raw voice as a fallback or confuse consent with provider authorization.
expectations: Expired assets do not satisfy Active authorization.
No automatic privacy workaround or resubmission.

evals.prompt: Strict prompt review only: restyle the whole 5.125-second source as felt using words only in the same place. Preserve frames, cuts, speed, final spoken word and independent sound tail. Images and extra probes are denied.
evals.expected_output: A strict words-only same place full-frame review with fractional source timing and sound locks unchanged. Missing optional images and the denied probe are not findings by themselves. No media or generation is performed.
assertions: Reviews the words-only full-frame medium direction under strict mode without requiring style or environment imagery.
Keeps the same place source-authoritative and preserves fractional timing, source offsets, frames, cuts, speed, final words and sound tails without rounding.
The denied partial probe is neither a prerequisite nor submitted; native Draft obligations remain exact-model and operation dependent.
Unknown full-duration mechanics remain unresolved feasibility, not permission to alter timing or block prompt-only review.
No media or generation, downloads, uploads, request writes or registry mutations occur.

evals.prompt: Review this words-only whole-frame painted restyle prompt in strict mode. Exact model capability is unknown and full-duration fractional support is unresolved. No probe is authorized; do not fetch capabilities or create files.
evals.expected_output: A prompt-only review separating creative findings from unresolved execution feasibility. Unknown support and no probe authority stop execution, not textual review. No media or generation is performed.
assertions: Provides prompt-only findings on reference authority and whole-frame medium coverage without inventing runtime controls.
Labels unknown fractional/full-duration support as unresolved and does not round source timing.
No probe is authorized or submitted; a future optional probe needs a specific bounded uncertainty, exact span and explicit additional generation approval.
Does not claim output photographic leftovers without actual output-QA evidence.
No media or generation, live capability calls, downloads, uploads, file writes or registry changes occur.

evals.prompt: Strict textual restyle review only. The source remains in the same room, but its far-wall texture is ambiguous. An optional same-place environment image is already selected and approved for that bounded ambiguity. Keep the whole frame ceramic; do not add people or props.
evals.expected_output: Uses the selected optional environment guide within its bounded authority while keeping source layout/timing authoritative and the whole frame ceramic. Photographic-background preservation is N/A. No media or generation is performed.
assertions: Optional environment guidance addresses the current bounded ambiguity and is used only because it is selected and authorized.
Does not treat a missing guide in a words-only alternative as a review failure or automatically generate another image.
Rejects imported unwanted people or props and does not let environment guidance override source motion, layout or timeline.
Marks photographic-background preservation N/A for whole-frame medium coverage; actual photographic leftovers require output-QA evidence.
No media or generation, downloads, uploads, request writes or task submissions occur.
